title: Sources: YouTube has held talks with publishers in recent months about an audiobook feature that could be ready next year and may be bundled in YouTube Premium (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: YouTube has held talks with publishers in recent months about an audiobook feature that could be ready next year and may be bundled in YouTube Premium — The Alphabet-owned streamer is working on a feature for audiobooks, a bid to compete with offerings from Spotify and Audible
